title: Nina Teicholz - 'Vegetable Oils: The Unknown Story'
summary: Nina Teicholz, author of The Big Fat Surprise, speaks at Low Carb Gold Coast 2017 about the history and health implications of vegetable and seed oils. She covers the political and institutional forces behind dietary fat advice.
why: Several HN commenters say it was memorable or life-changing and use it to argue against seed oils.

quote.text: This lecture on vegetable oils is one of the most memorable lectures I've ever watched
